capabilities.name: Clinic-sponsored destination access
capabilities.summary: Build-configured manually activated flat clinic sponsorship, proof-bound recoverable enrollment, signed installation-bound access, separate patient sharing consent and endpoint-scoped credentials. Sponsorship permits only approved API delivery and never sets personal purchase flags. Includes a production deployment package; disabled in unconfigured builds, with the isolated licensing service deployed and native store qualification pending.

capabilities.name: Clinic sync requests
capabilities.summary: A patient with clinic-sponsored sharing may separately allow the clinic to request a sync. The phone registers a delegated doorbell with the notification-only wake service and delivers its key only to the approved clinic endpoint; a ring shows fixed, device-localized copy and only the patient's tap runs a clinic export of yesterday and today. The wake service receives no clinic metadata. Implemented on both platforms; disabled until push credentials are configured, with physical-device notification QA pending.

apple.target: Complete APNs delivery, tap-to-export, revocation, and VoiceOver testing on a TestFlight build against the deployed wake service.

android.target: Configure Firebase for the Play build, then complete FCM delivery, Android 13+ notification permission, tap-to-export, revocation, and TalkBack testing on supported devices.

capabilities.name: Optional introduction to native store reviews
capabilities.summary: An optional purple review introduction for established users after successful export milestones or major/minor release notes. Feedback and dismissal remain available to everyone. Cooldowns record introductions and request attempts, never submitted ratings. No health data or new analytics are collected. iPhone and iPad use StoreKit for rating entry; explicit written-review actions open the App Store. The macOS companion does not present mobile review introductions.

android.target: Android review-introduction follow-up: adapt the optional purple introduction to Google Play review guidance, retain the 120-day attempt cooldown and F-Droid unavailable behavior, and wire release-note completion before enabling it.

capabilities.name: Apple Ads purchase attribution
capabilities.summary: Custom app analytics and advertising attribution are intentionally removed from the unpublished Apple and Android candidates.

apple.reason: Custom in-app analytics and advertising attribution are intentionally removed. Essential app services remain.

android.reason: Custom in-app analytics and advertising attribution are intentionally removed. Essential app services remain.

capabilities.name: Local diagnostic events and reviewed bundles
capabilities.summary: Inspect bounded privacy-classified technical events, separately opt into recording/sharing peer context, attach any existing original files including health exports, and explicitly review/save/share a frozen local ZIP without automatic uploads or new health reads.

capabilities.name: Local reporting fallback
capabilities.summary: Explain unsuccessful feedback handoffs and offer editable, copyable report text without requiring another external app.

android.target: Next Android support-settings update: replace the no-handler toast-only path with editable, copyable recipient/template/diagnostics text and injected ActivityNotFoundException regression coverage.

capabilities.name: Optional configuration account sign-in
capabilities.summary: Disabled synthetic configuration-only account authority exists; native sign-in, real browser consent, OS custody and registration remain unqualified. Signing in must preserve local-only use and never enable sync or health/export powers.

apple.target: AS03 closed native parser/lifecycle followed by approved browser/Keychain/callback/settings integration and AS12 iPhone/iPadOS/macOS qualification; real registration requires named mobile/security approval.

android.target: AS04 common Play/F-Droid closed parser/lifecycle followed by approved browser/Keystore/claimed-link/settings integration and AS12 physical/channel qualification, without Google identity dependencies.

capabilities.name: Selected portable profile synchronization
capabilities.summary: Independent proposed v1 codecs preserve portable preference bytes and exclude local authority. No durable service, native reconciliation/apply or dashboard profile library is enabled; sign-in transfers no profiles.

apple.target: AS06 private revision service, AS07 deterministic reconciliation and AS08 protected Apple mapping/pending-revision integration, then AS12 iPhone/iPadOS/macOS qualification and separately approved configuration privacy policy.

android.target: AS06 private revision service, AS07 deterministic reconciliation and AS09 common-channel protected native integration, then AS12 Play/F-Droid qualification and separately approved configuration privacy policy.

capabilities.name: Local immutable synchronized-revision approval
capabilities.summary: Fetched candidates must remain distinct from accepted execution snapshots and frozen jobs; new adoption stays unbound/blocked, with local protection, grants and explicit revision review before execution. Existing import-only gates do not qualify sync revisions.

apple.target: AS08/AS10 atomic native mapping/binding/protection/revision checks across manual, intent, direct and schedule admission; preserve frozen jobs, then AS12 supported-device qualification.

android.target: AS09/AS10 atomic common-channel native mapping/binding/protection/revision checks across UI, automation, direct and schedule admission; preserve frozen jobs, then AS12 physical qualification.

capabilities.name: Daily local export files
capabilities.summary: Create user-owned daily health exports in JSON, CSV, Markdown, and Obsidian Bases formats.

capabilities.name: Opt-in cloud API Endpoint receiver
capabilities.summary: An unbacked single-owner VM pilot retains API Endpoint compatibility envelopes without changing daily schemas. A dedicated public, token-authenticated write-only HTTPS receiver at api.healthmd.app shares the existing encrypted store while the original tailnet-only iPhone writer remains available. Android Raw API Snapshot NDJSON is not ingested; no general production cloud or third-party export credential exists.

apple.target: After ADR-0007 production security, privacy, deletion, and operational gates, qualify the existing iOS API Endpoint target against the approved HTTPS cloud receiver on a physical iPhone.

android.target: After ADR-0007 production gates, qualify the existing Android Compatibility Export API Endpoint target against the same approved HTTPS receiver on a physical Android device; Raw API Snapshot is a separate unsupported contract.

capabilities.name: Scoped read-only retained-export MCP
capabilities.summary: The unbacked VM pilot's public, separately authenticated read-only MCP serves bounded Apple-v8 daily aggregates. An explicitly scoped full-export token can additionally navigate all retained Apple/Android API Endpoint compatibility envelope bytes, including provider sidecars and historical revisions, without inventing cross-platform metric mappings. Distinct Muse aggregate-only and full-export credentials were issued with explicit owner consent; actual Muse vault capture and broader platform-client qualification remain planned.

apple.target: Qualify the new independently consented full-export scope on the deployed VM against real iPhone v8 envelopes without disclosing health values in tests/logs; retain the prior aggregate-only credential boundary, then validate a real hosted client.

android.target: Test complete retained Android v4/v5 compatibility envelope navigation against real Android API Endpoint exports without relabeling fields as Apple metrics; review registry equivalence separately before enabling any Android typed aggregate projection. Raw API Snapshot NDJSON requires a distinct ingestion decision.

capabilities.name: Requested-range summary
capabilities.summary: Write one independently versioned aggregate for immutable requested owner-date bounds, with explicit coverage and canonical units, while preserving daily export output.

android.target: Adopt healthmd.rollup_summary range semantics in the first Android writer for the new unified healthmd.health_data v9 profile; Android frozen v4 and analytical v5 remain byte-immutable.

capabilities.name: Sleep summaries and stages
capabilities.summary: Export sleep duration and the stages that both platform APIs expose using the shipped night_begins noon-to-noon summary window. Wake-date ownership requires the independently approved successor meanings and remains unavailable in these immutable profiles; production qualification is tracked by settings.sleep-attribution. Historical Apple v8 granular stages are window-clipped; Android v4/v5 detailed stages and parent records retain source intervals. This profile-specific detail difference does not imply equivalent raw projections or change summary ownership.

capabilities.name: Sleep day attribution
capabilities.summary: Current Apple and Android source admits explicit Morning ends successor profiles: whole sessions belong to the wake-up date without noon clipping, using the frozen export timezone and explicit attribution metadata. Historical Apple v8 and Android v4/v5 Night begins meanings and bytes remain unchanged. This source capability inventory does not claim that an unmerged branch is released.

capabilities.name: Activity basics
capabilities.summary: Export comparable steps, distance, energy, exercise, flights, wheelchair, and swimming activity.

capabilities.name: Heart and respiratory summaries
capabilities.summary: Export comparable heart-rate, respiratory-rate, and oxygen-saturation summaries; platform-specific HRV methods remain explicitly non-equivalent.

capabilities.name: Comparable vitals and body measurements
capabilities.summary: Export comparable pressure, glucose, temperature, weight, height, body fat, BMI, and lean-mass quantities.

capabilities.name: Comparable nutrient totals
capabilities.summary: Export nutrient quantities where units and meanings match across platform APIs.

capabilities.name: Mindfulness sessions
capabilities.summary: Export comparable mindfulness session totals without treating Apple State of Mind as equivalent.

capabilities.name: Selected detailed time-series
capabilities.summary: Export selected timestamped compatibility samples independently from platform-native source archive or raw snapshot products.

capabilities.name: Per-category export detail
capabilities.summary: Choose a default compatibility detail level and override it per category (sleep, activity, heart, vitals, nutrition, mobility, reproductive health, mindfulness, workouts, and body) without changing metric selection, daily summaries, file organization, or raw/canonical archives. Missing overrides reproduce the historical global switch exactly. An explicit Detailed override for a category whose records the shipped profile cannot represent selects the export.compatibility-detail-expansion successor profile; other overrides keep the shipped profiles.

capabilities.name: Individual sleep sessions
capabilities.summary: Export each source sleep session (for example a nap and an overnight sleep) separately from stage intervals, including a Markdown session table with full date, time, and source offset.

apple.reason: HealthKit exposes sleep as category-value intervals without a source session object; Health.md does not derive or label sessions it cannot read. Sleep stage intervals remain available as Detailed sleep.

capabilities.name: Expanded native compatibility detail
capabilities.summary: Per-record compatibility detail for natively exposed records that shipped profiles only summarize, written in additive successor profiles selected only by an explicit Detailed category override: apple-v12 adds start-owned detailSamples for HealthKit activity, nutrition, mobility, mindfulness, reproductive, body, temperature and spirometry samples, and per-stage source attribution on Detailed sleep stages (Android sleep sessions already carry their Health Connect data origin); android-analytical-v7 adds Health Connect calorie, distance, floors, elevation, hydration and body record arrays. Each entry keeps its source timestamps, interval, unit and identity; no points are interpolated or deduplicated. The record types are platform_distinct (HealthKit samples vs Health Connect records) and are never presented as parity. Morning ends (apple-v11, android-sleep-v6), frozen v4, daily notes and Bases frontmatter keep their shipped profiles.

capabilities.name: Completed workouts
capabilities.summary: Export completed workout sessions and detail time series exposed by each source API. Optional Details/Metadata table presentation is staged separately: Apple is available; Android is planned for its first unified-v9 Markdown presentation-settings/profile writer (current v4/v5 renderers already use bullets without these tables). See the independently versioned workout-presentation parity record.

capabilities.name: Lossless HealthKit source archive
capabilities.summary: Preserve the public HealthKit source representation embedded by Apple v7.

android.reason: Health Connect records are not HealthKit objects and cannot provide HealthKit UUID, source-revision, device, relationship, or archive semantics.

capabilities.name: HealthKit medication dose events
capabilities.summary: Export the HealthKit medication catalog and scheduled, taken, and skipped dose events.

android.reason: Health Connect PHR may expose medication-related FHIR resources but has no equivalent medication dose-event catalog.

capabilities.name: HealthKit State of Mind
capabilities.summary: Export mood, valence, labels, associations, and momentary emotion values from HealthKit.

android.reason: The audited Health Connect API has no comparable State of Mind or mood record.

capabilities.name: Apple Watch wrist temperature
capabilities.summary: Export Apple Watch wrist-temperature measurements without aliasing Android skin-temperature deltas.

android.reason: Health Connect skin-temperature delta and baseline records have different sensor and data semantics.

capabilities.name: Mobility and performance metrics
capabilities.summary: Export explicitly mapped walking, running, cycling, cadence, and power metrics while preserving platform-specific selectors and aggregations.

capabilities.name: Saved export profiles
capabilities.summary: Save multiple named export configurations with independent metric selection, formats, output options, and destinations, and run any of them manually, from automation, or on independent schedules. On Apple, profile management is currently documented and QA-attested on iPhone only; iPad and macOS management availability is not claimed. Profiles choose which request produces files; they never change the public export schema, which remains healthmd.health_data per output profile.

capabilities.name: Archive coverage calendar
capabilities.summary: Show which health dates each export profile covered, with per-date status and gaps, rather than when exports ran.

capabilities.name: Agent Data gateway export destination
capabilities.summary: Upload a profile's exact exported artifacts to a configured self-hosted Agent Data ingestion gateway endpoint per ingestion protocol v1, with health-free per-artifact receipts and bounded retry of transient outcomes.

capabilities.name: Automation exports can include today
capabilities.summary: Allow an automation to export N calendar days ending today when explicitly requested; default to ending yesterday. API-targeted profiles upload through the existing platform API runner. Current-day data remains incomplete and public daily schemas are unchanged.

android.target: Follow up #252 in AutomationReceiver.ACTION_EXPORT_LAST_DAYS with an INCLUDE_TODAY boolean extra defaulting false, preserving N-day count and profile API routing, with date-window regression tests.

capabilities.name: Scheduled exports refresh today's file
capabilities.summary: A scheduled export keeps the current day's partial file fresh alongside completed-day trailing windows, so a daytime run captures last night's sleep in addition to yesterday. The user outcome is unified; the native mechanism differs: Apple and Android profiles offer best-effort same-day refresh windows every 30 or 60 minutes, or 3, 6, or 12 hours, independently of completed-day cadence, and the Android single schedule offers a 'past complete days + today' window that pairs with its sub-day cadence. Shared Setup v2 remains frozen: its Apple typed extension supports only 3/6/12-hour refresh, and sharing a native 30/60-minute choice is explicitly blocked on both platforms rather than rounded or omitted. Local persistence v2 disables minute refresh for older apps and retains the minute choice without reactivating it after downgrade edits.

capabilities.name: Discard pending scheduled recovery per profile
capabilities.summary: On iPhone and Android, explicitly abandon one profile's frozen scheduled recovery without recreating profiles, re-entering credentials, deleting completed exports/history, or rewinding completed-day and refresh progress. Late worker callbacks are fenced; enabled schedules wait for the next ordinary occurrence and disabled schedules remain disabled. Native regression/device qualification and release remain separate from source implementation.

capabilities.name: Verify original API recovery authority before capture
capabilities.summary: New iPhone scheduled recovery pins the original endpoint, credential and profile binding before capture/upload and blocks unverifiable legacy API requests. Android already freezes pending endpoint URLs and pins credentials/headers in prepared compatibility journals; equivalent pre-journal and Raw API Snapshot pending-request credential evidence remains planned, not claimed as parity.

android.target: In the next Android scheduler-hardening change, persist private credential/destination evidence when creating pending API work, pass it to compatibility and raw runners, fail closed before capture after credential changes, and verify pre-journal, legacy, raw and prepared-journal cases on an SDK-equipped host without changing v4/v5 or raw-snapshot v1.

capabilities.name: Cancel an in-progress automated export
capabilities.summary: Stop the current automated export attempt without disabling its schedule. Completed dates remain completed, and unresolved dates remain eligible for a later retry.

capabilities.name: Choose what happens when an automation's runs overlap
capabilities.summary: Per-automation choice between queueing a new scheduled occurrence behind the running one or skipping it while one is in progress. Skipped days remain eligible for the next due evaluation.

android.target: Add a per-profile Queue/Skip choice to the Android automation detail and map it onto ScheduledProfileExportWorker's unique-work policy (APPEND_OR_REPLACE for Queue, KEEP for Skip) instead of the fixed REPLACE in ExportScheduler, with scheduler tests for both policies.

capabilities.name: HealthKit hearing and symptom records
capabilities.summary: Export HealthKit hearing exposure and symptom categories that have no Health Connect equivalent.

android.reason: The audited Health Connect API does not expose equivalent records for these HealthKit metrics.

capabilities.name: Health Connect activity intensity
capabilities.summary: Export moderate/vigorous activity-intensity intervals and totals.

apple.reason: HealthKit exercise time and physical effort are not equivalent to a Health Connect ActivityIntensityRecord.

capabilities.name: Health Connect planned workouts
capabilities.summary: Export planned exercise sessions, blocks, steps, titles, and notes.

apple.reason: Apple v7 can archive WorkoutKit schedules, but it does not model Android planned-workout blocks and steps as the same cross-platform projection.

capabilities.name: Health Connect menstruation periods
capabilities.summary: Export menstruation period intervals, day counts, and entries.

apple.reason: Apple menstrual-flow samples answer a different question and are not modeled as Health Connect period intervals.

capabilities.name: Health Connect PHR/FHIR resources
capabilities.summary: Export feature-gated Health Connect Personal Health Record resources and raw FHIR metadata.

apple.reason: The Android PHR product surface is not equivalent to HealthKit clinical records or medication dose events.

capabilities.name: Health Connect nutrition meals
capabilities.summary: Export meal records with name, type, timing, and energy-from-fat context.

apple.reason: The Apple product currently exports aggregate nutrient quantities and does not model equivalent meal records.

capabilities.name: Health Connect contextual fields
capabilities.summary: Export Health Connect measurement context such as meal/specimen, location, source notes, and VO2 method.

apple.reason: Generic HealthKit metadata is not a stable equivalent to these first-class Health Connect fields.

capabilities.name: Health Connect skin temperature
capabilities.summary: Export Health Connect skin-temperature baselines and deltas without aliasing Apple wrist temperature.

apple.reason: Apple Watch wrist temperature has different sensor and data semantics from Health Connect skin temperature.

capabilities.name: Typed WHOOP daily provider section
capabilities.summary: Embed reviewed WHOOP cycle, recovery, sleep, workout, and current-day body snapshot data in historical Apple v8/WHOOP v1 and current Apple v10/WHOOP v2 while retaining provider-native sidecars. Physiological-cycle steps are distinct from primary civil-day steps.

android.reason: Android frozen v4 and analytical v5 remain unchanged; Android adoption requires a new reviewed public profile.

capabilities.name: WHOOP physiological-cycle steps
capabilities.summary: Retain bounded exact cycle step counts with provider IDs and cycle timestamps in Apple daily v10/WHOOP v2; never alias, sum or prorate them into primary civil-day steps or roll-ups. Missing/null is unavailable and explicit zero is meaningful. Existing read:cycles scope suffices.

android.target: Add independently versioned typed WHOOP provider-cycle counts and the same per-profile/per-job cycles resource control to Android Play using public Cycle.step_count and read:cycles; preserve frozen v4/v5 primary steps and selected native Raw API Snapshots. F-Droid remains Health Connect-only.

capabilities.name: WHOOP export data selection
capabilities.summary: Choose WHOOP cycles, recovery, sleep, workouts, and body resources independently from platform health metrics; persist and freeze selections per export profile/job and enforce them before provider reads and native/typed output. iPhone controls are available when Connected Apps is enabled; Android Play controls are staged.

android.target: Add the same cycles/recovery/sleep/workouts/body Health Metrics controls to Android Play, persist all-on/partial/all-off selections per profile and frozen job, and apply them before WHOOP compatibility reads and Raw API Snapshot endpoint planning while preserving frozen v4/v5 grammar and the cloud-free F-Droid channel.

capabilities.name: Private platform health database export
capabilities.summary: Export private or undocumented vendor database fields that public SDKs do not expose.

apple.reason: Health.md is limited to public HealthKit and WorkoutKit APIs and cannot access Apple's private health database.

android.reason: Health.md is limited to public Health Connect APIs and cannot access private provider databases.

capabilities.name: Direct CLI QR pairing
capabilities.summary: Pair either mobile platform to the portable CLI from one in-app QR and shared 20-digit authentication profile, with manual entry fallback.

capabilities.name: Direct full public and authorized health corpus
capabilities.summary: Capture every public record type supported by the selected mobile integration and authorized by the user as a durable platform-native CLI or local-MCP raw artifact, with truthful completeness evidence and bounded job-bound MCP reads.

capabilities.name: Direct CLI agent wake window
capabilities.summary: Keep an unavailable direct query, export, resume, or cancellation request waiting for a bounded, cancellable window so opening either mobile app unblocks the same in-flight request.

capabilities.name: Direct CLI agent push wake
capabilities.summary: Send one authenticated, health-free, rate-limited notification for an enrolled paired device while the shared wake window holds; the tap restores user presence but never authorizes background health access.

android.target: Implement RFC-0005 P3 with FCM for Play builds, explicit P1-only degradation for F-Droid and force-stopped apps, and matching enrollment, revocation, notification, and physical-device gates.

capabilities.name: Authorized history window detection
capabilities.summary: On OS 27+ with a supported HealthKit SDK build, report HealthKit's user-selected earliest readable sample date, treat earlier history as unknown, and reject unqualified full-history claims for limited, unknown, or unassessed scopes; older Apple runtimes, unsupported SDK builds, and local Mac queries report api_unavailable and require explicit ranges.

android.reason: Health Connect permission and history-access APIs do not expose a per-record-type user-selected earliest readable date equivalent to HealthKit earliestAuthorizedSampleDate(for:). Android continues to report its independently defined permission/history status without an Apple-shaped placeholder.

capabilities.name: Share My Setup
capabilities.summary: Export, review, and transactionally import a bounded portable setup profile without health data, credentials, device grants, purchases, or runtime state; v2 transaction semantics are wired host-side behind explicit caller-supplied seams and stay deferred with default writers on the one and only v2 contract while physical-device interoperability and accessibility QA remain before availability.

apple.target: Complete Messages, AirDrop, Files, cold/warm document-open, VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, rollback, and Undo testing on supported Apple devices.

android.target: Complete Sharesheet, OpenDocument/CreateDocument, cold/warm intent, TalkBack, large-font, RTL, rollback, and Undo testing on supported Android devices.

capabilities.name: Shared Rust metric registry
capabilities.summary: Own stable metric identities, profile order, units, aliases, and backed/unavailable decisions in one deterministic registry.

capabilities.name: Shared Rust output profile engine
capabilities.summary: Run deterministic post-capture modeling and serialization through the shared Rust core on both native products.

apple.target: Migrate provider-free Apple v8 through legacy, shadow, and Rust profile-scoped gates while provider sections remain native-authoritative.

android.target: Migrate frozen v4 and analytical v5 independently through legacy, shadow, and Rust profile-scoped gates.

capabilities.name: Complimentary myself.md access claim
capabilities.summary: Disabled by default behind explicit build feature flags on both platforms. When enabled on iOS/iPadOS and Google Play Android, present a user-reviewed claim screen, verify eligible purchase evidence with myself.md, then hand off to explicit browser account confirmation. Opening the screen grants no access. Free macOS companion and F-Droid access do not establish a qualifying purchase.

capabilities.name: First free export and paid access
capabilities.summary: On iOS/iPadOS and Google Play Android, onboarding guides users into creating an automation and running their first export for free. Further exports require active paid access. Setup, automation editing, previews, and existing files remain reachable. Historical usage is preserved through purchase, restore, and expiry. Eligible subscriptions retain store-backed trials. Free macOS companion and F-Droid Full Access are unchanged.

capabilities.name: Native Apple Family Sharing plans
capabilities.summary: Higher-priced Family weekly, yearly, and Lifetime plans use Apple Family Sharing. No custom family accounts or cross-platform entitlement transfer.

android.reason: Owner-approved individual-only Google Play offering. Google Play Family Library does not share in-app purchases or subscriptions; custom family account/invite infrastructure is explicitly out of scope.
